clauses.requiredBehavior: Distinguish implementation inspection, independent qualification, competent certification and final integration; preserve independence wherever required.
clauses.prohibitedShortcut: Fit an oracle to implementation or substitute developer tests.
clauses.binding: Freeze the execution protocol, expected results and instrument hashes BEFORE any candidate execution; your own scope and oracle, not the builder's or the coordinator's test selection; the coordinator's static predictions are PROPOSALS to be probed, not expectations. Claims allowed: 'isolated end-to-end' only if the binding-diff of persisted versus live-world decision is exactly the member leaf plus its digest; otherwise 'joint' with the diff recorded; never 'A25(a)/(e) PASS' from component evidence.

clauses.requiredBehavior: Retain consequential decision ancestry, rejected alternatives, objections, adverse findings and supersession where legitimately relevant, subject to privacy and retention limits.
clauses.prohibitedShortcut: Delete, relabel, overwrite or silently rescore failures.
clauses.binding: Retain every raw log, failure, probe, exclusion and amendment append-only; the original F3-A FAIL (23 assertions), the readjudication 1-failed G4 result and the M06 original SURVIVED record are permanent predecessor evidence; never relabel or silently rescore. Preserve the original A25(a)/A25(e) UNREACHABLE-ISOLATED records and AMEND-3/4 history; report disagreement with them as a new finding, not as a correction.

clauses.requiredBehavior: Bind claims to exact source, configuration, governing context and transition evidence; reconstruct authoritative pathways when deterministic execution replay is impossible.
clauses.binding: Bind every claim to exact source (tree id), Registry pin, interpreter, dependency versions and harness hash. Python 3.11 results do not transfer to 3.12 or the reverse; 739efe7 results do not transfer to 8616d5f or main without tree and AST derivation. The F5 class-age fixture is new code: record its source hash; the GRAFT route relies on the documented unsigned store and must carry that label.
